latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Facebook Editor AI — Edit and Export Facebook Videos.

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM (up to 500MB) and get 1080p MP4 edits in 30–60 seconds.
- AI-driven editing: trim, resize, add captions, text overlays, audio tracks, and more.
- Automatic backend connection and authentication with free starter credits.
- Export fully formatted Facebook videos, optimized for feed and ads.
- Supports preview, batch processing, and iterative editing via cloud GPUs.
- User-friendly prompts, with session-based state for ongoing projects.
